metadata.description: Reusable Claude Code skills from Busy Office. Install the busy-office plugin to get every skill, namespaced as busy-office:<skill>.

plugins.name: busy-office
plugins.description: progress-dashboard — one-page stakeholder progress dashboard for any git project, built from whatever records it keeps (ADRs, roadmaps, gates, backlogs, changelogs, PRs). loop-doctor — explains how a scheduled autonomous loop works, finds redundant/contradictory/invalid detail across the files that govern it, and prescribes improvements. loop-economist — measures what a loop's actual runs cost and produced from session transcripts and git, scores six dimensions and prescribes fixes. requeue — reviews and reorders the queue the loop is fed, splits it into loop/subloop/gauntlet/human lanes and sharpens vague items into tasks. sharpen-intent — sharpens the intent/objective/key-focus document the whole ranking chain bottoms out in, and reports which work traces back to it. loop-atlas — draws the whole loop as one animated picture and the agents that run it as a deck of cards. wake-weight — what a run pays before it does any work, and what to cut. solo-flow — trunk-based git branching and release model for a repo with exactly one writer (an agent or a loop), and when a develop branch actually earns its keep instead. graph-engineer — redraws a linear agent or prompt chain as an orchestration graph (contracts, fan-out, earned barriers, verifiers, converging cycles, model tiering), reviews and lints existing Workflow scripts, and estimates agents, critical path and cost before a run. jev — a typed second opinion from jev-ai.pro (PASS / REVIEW / FAIL with probabilities) before claiming a task done, routing work, trusting research, releasing or running a risky tool call; evidence the CLI collects itself, per-project allow, audit log; the API key is asked for at install.
